title: Thank You (Long | 500 Patrons)
description: This recording was first released during the Summer of 2018 — as thanks to those supporting Shibby — and marking a major milestone on Patreon. With the upcoming rebrand of my Patreon, I want to take the opportunity to look back over my Home feed and include some of the most memorable moments here. So I'll be sharing a few audios to reminisce over past posts, and perhaps showcase things you may have missed over the many years. Thank You Holy fuck. Over five hundred now people support me on here. And um — I'm not really sure what to say other then thank you, so much. It really does make me feel so loved, and I appreciate it, for the files I create. Thanks to all of you. This is what I do for a living now. I have all the time in the world to write and record and create everything my kinky heart desires. And I love all of you. All of my listeners. I love those that can't support me financially, those who just upvote and like. As that helps me out a lot with visibility. Those who comment, and message, are honestly the best. I really like that people can go to one of my reddit threads, and see all the reviews for a file. To see if they like it or not. And I love the comments. I love all of those too shy for any of that, those who just like to listen. And I even love those of you for who — well, really this is just your porn — you don't give a fuck. But your getting off, still gets me off. So it all works out great. But those of you on here who put your money where your cock is. You guys are the best of all. Because of you, I get to be me. And I get real concrete proof that my files are loved and supported. And people aren't just being nice — no you guys really do enjoy my creations. And I enjoy your enjoyment of what I really consider to be my art. I'm not really sure how to thank you guys. I just wanted you to know that you make me so happy. And don't worry if your pledge is low or anything. I believe very firmly that real life should absolutely come first. And you should only be pledging to me if it is trivial to you. Thank you so much for supporting me. Hopefully I'll be doing this for decades to come. And hopefully, you guys will be listening for decades to come. ♡
author: Mistress Shibby
